title: Hierarchical Semantic Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities
abstract: arXiv:2611.34184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) in real-world systems must handle unpredictable modality missingness caused by sensor failures, privacy masking, and unstable transmission. Existing methods either learn reliability-aware representations or reconstruct missing inputs, often using a single flattened encoder output. This overlooks deep encoders' semantic hierarchy and intra- and inter-modal interactions, causing semantic averaging and ill-posed mappings. We propose Hierarchical Semantic Learning (HSL), a framework that exploits semantic hierarchy for robust MSA with missing modalities. Hierarchical Semantic Decoupling exposes low-, mid-, and high-level feature streams from each modality encoder. Cross-Modal Cross-Level Semantic Reconstruction performs ladder-style recovery, using high-level semantics from observed modalities as global anchors to progressively reconstruct mid-level structures and low-level details of missing modalities.

translated_title: 面向模态缺失多模态情感分析的层级语义学习
translated_abstract: 现实系统中的多模态情感分析（MSA）必须处理由传感器故障、隐私遮挡和不稳定传输引起的不可预测的模态缺失。现有方法要么学习可靠性感知的表示，要么重建缺失的输入，且通常仅使用单一扁平化的编码器输出。这忽略了深度编码器的语义层级以及模态内和模态间的交互，导致语义平均化和病态映射。我们提出了层级语义学习（HSL）框架，利用语义层级来实现对模态缺失鲁棒的多模态情感分析。层级语义解耦从每个模态编码器中提取出低层、中层和高层特征流。跨模态跨层级语义重建执行梯式恢复，以观测模态的高层语义作为全局锚点，逐步重建缺失模态的中层结构和低层细节。
tldr: 提出层级语义学习框架HSL，通过层级语义解耦与跨模态跨层级梯式重建，以观测模态的高层语义为全局锚点逐级恢复缺失模态的中层结构与低层细节，提升模态缺失场景下多模态情感分析的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Hierarchical Semantic Learning (HSL), a framework that exploits the semantic hierarchy of deep encoders by using high-level semantics of observed modalities as global anchors to progressively reconstruct missing modalities' mid-level structures and low-level details, enabling robust multimodal sentiment analysis under modality missingness.
